parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DBName
parameters.description: The name of the database. You can revoke all permissions of the account on this database. Separate multiple databases with commas (,).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds revoke-account-privilege --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --account-name test1 --db-name testDB --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds RevokeAccountPrivilege --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --DBName testDB --AccountName test1
